services.desc: Discover the thrilling and picturesque experiences offered by Nanaimo Adventure Charter’s tours, with a wide range of services catering to various preferences and occasions. Whether you’re seeking a leisurely cruise, a customized adventure, or a special event, Merek will have the perfect option for you. Explore the possibilities below: Set sail on a comfortable and well-equipped boat, allowing you to enjoy the scenic beauty of the Nanaimo coastline. Cruise at your own pace, taking in the breathtaking views and immersing yourself in the tranquil waters. Guided fishing charters offer 3-hour to all-day trips with all gear and expert guidance included. Customized adventures and special event charters are available, including Celebration of Life ceremonies with ocean memorials.
